comments.author: yozhao101
comments.body: [Update]: I reproduced this issue on a Dual ToR `str2-7050cx3-acs-8`. The `test_memory_checker` will install a utility `stress` in the `streaming telemetry` container. But the `stress` utility sometimes can not be installed correctly. I am working on to figure out the root reason why the installation failed.

comments.author: yozhao101
comments.body: [Update]: This pytest script failed only on Dual ToR and passed all single ToR testing.

comments.author: yozhao101
comments.body:
@lguohan @yxieca 

 [Update **Root Cause**]: 
The logic of this pytest script `test_memory_checker.py` is as following:
1. (Fixture function) Reduces the monitoring interval of Monit from 60 seconds to 10 seconds.
2. Installs the `stress` utility in `streaming telemetry` container.
3. Runs `stress` utility to consume more than 400MB memory.
4. Checks whether the `streaming telemetry` container will be restarted or not.

One sentence to summarize the root cause is the step 1 was executed on DuT `str2-7050cx3-08` and steps 2, 3, 4 were executed on another DuT `str2-7050cx3-acs-09`. I think this behavior was not expected.

In detail, I ran this pytest script against the testbed `vms17-dual-t0-7050-2`. The Dual ToR `str2-7050cx3-acs-8` was selected to run this test. Monit control file `monitrc` on this device `str2-7050cx3-acs-8` was changed such that Monit will check each monitoring item every 10 seconds. But the interesting thing is the `stress` utility was installed on another DuT `str2-7050cx3-acs-9` and then
`stress` utility was called to consume memory. Since `stress` utility was not installed and ran on DuT `str2-7050cx3-acs-8`, logAnalyzer was unable to find the corresponding syslog messages and then failed this pytest script.

I also checked the syslog of nightly test at the testbed `vms17-dual-t0-7050-1` on 8/16/2021 and found the same issue. The link of syslog is here: https://dev.azure.com/mssonic/internal/_build/results?buildId=29381&view=artifacts&pathAsName=false&type=publishedArtifacts.

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
This PR aims to parameterize this test case with different container names such that individual test case will be ran against each container. This method will avoid using a loop to iterate each container in a single test case. For testing on Dual ToR, this method can avoid the fixture function runs on upper ToR and test case runs on lower ToR. This PR will fix https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/8430. 

#### How did you do it?
Currently we already has this infrastructure. The parameter `enum_dut_feature_container`  will be initialized with the combination of DuT and container names. The function `decode_dut_port_name(...)` will parse each string to get DuT name and container name.

#### How did you verify/test it?
I tested this change on Dual ToR `str2-7050cx3-acs-06, str2-7050cx3-acs-07` and single ToR `str-msn2700-03`.

comments.author: bingwang-ms
comments.body: I checked the issue, and it feels like that the best way to address such issue is to ensure that the test is running on the DUT that ```stress``` utility was installed on. We have a fixture ```rand_selected_dut``` which will randomly select a DUT from both ToRs. Just use that fixture to replace ```duthost``` will address the issue, I guess.
